title: Potential RBCD attack path to privileged account
impact: A controllable write primitive over a computer plus the ability to add/control a machine account can set up resource-based constrained delegation and impersonate a privileged user to that host.
remediation: Set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota=0; remove non-default write rights on computer objects; audit msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity.
description: RBCD prerequisites observed together: a write primitive over a computer object AND the ability to create/control a machine account. Chain may enable impersonation to the target computer.

title: Chained ACL path toward a privileged group
impact: A write right over an object that is itself a member of (or can modify) a privileged group can be chained to add a controlled principal to that group.
remediation: Review and remove non-default write ACEs on admin-protected objects; enable AdminSDHolder review.
description: A dangerous write ACE was observed together with a privileged-group reference on the same domain; the ACE may be chainable toward that group.

title: Unusual delegation + credential-exposure combination
impact: Delegation combined with a nearby credential-read primitive can create an unexpected privilege boundary crossing that is not captured by a single-finding detection.
remediation: Treat delegation hosts as tier-0; remove nearby credential-read exposure; validate the delegation target set.
description: Delegation and a credential-exposure primitive co-occur on the same host. The combination is worth manual review as an unrecognized attack path.
